dct_title_s: Revised plan for the improvement of Sumner Field, Minneapolis, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: A propsal for an extension of the Municipal Golf Course in Glenwood Park, Minneapolis, Minnesota. The plan is found in the Thirty-fifth Annual Report of the Board of Park Commissioners of the City of Minneapolis, after page 38.
